name: Kura
source:
Main character lives in an old large mansion. His earliest memories date back to elementary school 10 years ago. The big scar on his head is said to be the result of a car crash accident. On his graduation day he finds a childhood photo in the storehouse and finally learns the truth... He starts revenge on his current family by drugging the girls and training them in the storeroom.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公吾妻大辅住在一座古老而宽敞的宅邸。他最早的记忆始于十年前的小学时代，家人告诉他，头上的巨大伤疤来自一场交通事故。大学毕业当天，他在仓库里发现了一张童年照片，终于得知真相……为了向如今的家人复仇，他开始给家中女孩下药，再把她们带到仓库调教。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
